title: Predicted osteoarthritis effector genes
bodyHtml: These manually curated effector gene predictions from the Genetics of Osteoarthritis Consortium (Boer, Hatzikotoulas, Southam, et al., 2021) incorporate genetic, regulatory, and perturbational evidence types. Genes are assigned a score from 1 to 6, with 6 representing the strongest evidence. Click the "View" button to see the supporting evidence for each prediction. Find full descriptions of the evidence and method on the "Research method" tab.
